title: Attention Is All You Need
summary: Introduced the Transformer architecture, replacing recurrence with multi-head self-attention for sequence transduction.
whyRoot: This paper introduced the transformer architecture — the foundation of virtually all modern large language models and vision transformers. Nearly every subsequent breakthrough in NLP and multimodal AI traces back to this work.
importanceReason: One of the most cited papers in ML history. The transformer architecture is the backbone of GPT, BERT, and virtually all modern LLMs.

children.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
children.summary: Introduced masked language modeling and next-sentence prediction for bidirectional pre-training of transformer encoders.
children.howExtends: Applied the Transformer encoder with bidirectional masked language modeling, enabling deep contextualized representations for downstream NLP tasks.
children.importanceReason: Set new SOTA on 11 NLP benchmarks and established the pre-train then fine-tune paradigm.

children.title: RoBERTa: A Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach
children.summary: Systematically optimized BERT pretraining with dynamic masking, larger batches, and more data.
children.howExtends: Showed that BERT was significantly undertrained — with careful hyperparameter tuning and more data, RoBERTa matched or exceeded BERT's performance.
children.importanceReason: Demonstrated that training methodology matters as much as architecture, influencing all subsequent LLM pretraining.

children.title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners (GPT-2)
children.summary: Showed that large-scale language models can perform multiple tasks zero-shot without explicit supervision.
children.howExtends: Applied the Transformer decoder in an autoregressive framework at scale, demonstrating emergent zero-shot abilities.
children.importanceReason: Demonstrated that scaling transformers leads to emergent capabilities, directly paving the way for GPT-3 and ChatGPT.

children.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (GPT-3)
children.summary: Scaled GPT-2 to 175B parameters, showing that few-shot in-context learning emerges at sufficient scale.
children.howExtends: Massively scaled the GPT-2 autoregressive transformer approach, demonstrating in-context learning as an emergent property of scale.
children.importanceReason: The 175B parameter model that demonstrated scaling laws and in-context learning, launching the modern LLM era.

children.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale (ViT)
children.summary: Applied a pure transformer directly to image patches, achieving SOTA on ImageNet with sufficient pre-training data.
children.howExtends: Applied the Transformer architecture to computer vision by treating image patches as tokens, replacing CNNs with attention.
children.importanceReason: Demonstrated that transformers can match or beat CNNs in vision, opening the field of vision transformers.

children.title: Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows
children.summary: Introduced shifted window attention for efficient hierarchical vision transformers, achieving SOTA across multiple vision benchmarks.
children.howExtends: Addressed ViT's lack of hierarchical feature maps and high computational cost with shifted window-based self-attention.
children.importanceReason: Made transformers practical for dense vision tasks like detection and segmentation with a strong inductive bias.

children.title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer (T5)
children.summary: Proposed a unified text-to-text framework where every NLP task is cast as text generation using an encoder-decoder transformer.
children.howExtends: Extended the original Transformer encoder-decoder with a unified text-to-text format, systematically studying transfer learning at scale.
children.importanceReason: Provided a clean unified framework for NLP and a systematic study of transfer learning that influenced many subsequent models.

children.title: Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models (Flan-T5)
children.summary: Fine-tuned T5 with instruction-tuning across a massive collection of tasks, showing strong generalization and reasoning improvements.
children.howExtends: Applied instruction fine-tuning to T5, demonstrating that scaling the number of fine-tuning tasks improves zero-shot performance on held-out tasks.
children.importanceReason: Showed the power of instruction tuning at scale, a key technique behind modern chat models.

children.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision (CLIP)
children.summary: Trained a vision-language model on 400M image-text pairs using contrastive learning, enabling zero-shot transfer to many visual tasks.
children.howExtends: Combined transformer-based text and image encoders with contrastive learning, enabling zero-shot visual classification from natural language.
children.importanceReason: Made zero-shot visual recognition practical and became the foundation for multimodal models like DALL-E and GPT-4V.
